text:
Jordan: Weekend poll: rooftop picnic + sunset photos or wander the farmers market & get pastries? 1 vote per person :sun_with_face: :croissant:

Priya: rooftop picnic for sure. got a tiny Bluetooth speaker and a frisbee. also can bring my famous tzatziki. :yum:

Mei: farmers market FTW. there9s a new stall doing ricotta doughnuts. i9m weak for doughnuts.

Carlos: both sound delightful. i volunteer to be photographer if rooftop. rooftop needs blankets & bug spray?

ops-bot: Heads up: rooftop access requires booking with facilities if >8 people. Contact facilities@redwood.example by Friday.

Jordan: good call ops-bot. planning for a small group (4-6). i9ll ping facilities. price for rooftop booking?

Priya: also weather check plz? don't want to lug a speaker in the rain.

weather-bot: Saturday 17:00 6: Cloud cover 10%. Temp 20b0C / 68b0F. Winds light. Rain chance 5%. Good for sunset.

Mei: oh sold. rooftop it is then. but if more people want market + pastry run afterwards, i'm not stopping them. :doughnut:

Jordan: plan: meet 17:30 rooftop level 6. I9ll DM facilities & create a calendar invite: ```/calendar create "Rooftop Sunset Picnic" Sat 17:30 Roof L6```

ops-bot: Event created: "Rooftop Sunset Picnic" Sat 17:30 b7 Invited: Jordan, Priya, Mei, Carlos. Facilities notified.

Carlos: I'll bring blankets (and camera). Mei, you must bring doughnuts for science.

Priya: bringing tzatziki + pita. anyone allergic to sesame?

Mei: no sesame here. also, if we need a backup plan, farmers market at 8am Sunday sounds safe.

Jordan: perfect. backup noted. see you all Saturday! :camera_with_flash: :sun_with_face:
